content_blocks.text: The lighthouse stood tall and proud against the stormy sea, its beam cutting through the darkness like a guiding hand. Inside, the keeper’s daughter, Elara, sat by the window, watching the waves crash against the shore. Her father had always taught her to find beauty in the chaos, to see the stars even when they were obscured by clouds. As she gazed out, a distant ship appeared on the horizon, its lights flickering in the tumultuous sea. Elara felt a surge of determination, knowing that her father would be waiting, ready to guide the ship safely to port. She resolved to take on more of the responsibilities, to become the lighthouse’s true guardian, even if it meant facing the tempest alone.
